To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the expression of TPOH m RNAs is initiated before the setting up of the sympathetic innervation, that the expression of these m RNAs is modulated by the noradrenergically mediated induction of aralkylamine N -acetyltransferase, and that the development of the pineal gland is heterogeneous.

TPOH m RNAs were found in the rat pinea gland before the arrival of noradrenergigic fibers, suggesting that the initiation of pinealocyte differentiation is not under the control of noradrenerigic innervation, and that TPOH expression is not homogeneous in the pineal parenchyma during the first two postnatal weeks, suggesting that the maturation of pinealocytes is not synchronized.
TPH mRNA is expressed before the sympathetic innervation of the pineal gland, and that TPH mRNA expression is correlated with the maturation of pinealocytes.
